title: Rust lichen-schc decompress/compress skips profile revalidation Python enforces for rules 2/3/4
description:
Cross-impl divergence confirmed empirically on 2026-08-25 while adding rule 2/3/4 vectors (l1qw.3.5.2.7/3.5.3.7/3.5.4.7). Three concrete cases where Python (lichen.schc.headers) and Rust (lichen-schc codec.rs) disagree:

1) DECOMPRESS rule 2: Python decompress_packet rebuilds then re-runs Icmpv6EchoProfile.matches() and rejects non-Echo types (headers.py:851 'rule 2 residue does not reconstruct its packet profile'). Rust decompress_icmpv6_echo (codec.rs:971) writes icmp_type from the residue unvalidated: crafted residue 0240000000000000000100000000000000029babcd000770696e67 yields an ICMPv6 type=155 packet under the Echo rule. Probe output: 'RUST ACCEPTED rule-2 non-echo type'.

2) DECOMPRESS rule 4: Python rejects residues whose kd_flags lack the D flag (RplDaoProfile.matches requires kd_flags&0x40); Rust decompress_rpl_dao (codec.rs:1096) accepts, reconstructing a no-DODAGID DAO under the with-DODAGID rule. Probe: flipping byte 19 to 0x00 in the canonical rpl_dao compressed blob decodes Ok in Rust.

3) COMPRESS side: Python profiles verify icmpv6_checksum==0 before selecting rules 2/3/4 (headers.py _RplProfile/Icmpv6EchoProfile.matches), so a bad-checksum echo falls back to Rule 255; Rust compress dispatches on type/code/link-local only (codec.rs:2007-2038), so the same packet is Rule-2 compressed. Probe: 'RUST compressed bad-checksum echo with rule byte 2' vs Python rule byte 255. Same gap applies to DIO/DAO.

Impact: shared-vector corpus cannot encode cases 1-3 as vectors without failing one implementation; malformed/mutated residues produce packets whose inner protocol type contradicts the SCHC rule ID on the Rust path (downstream dispatch hazard). Fix direction: add post-build matches() revalidation to Rust per-rule decompress fns (mirroring headers.py:851-852) and ICMPv6 checksum verification to the Rust compress dispatch; then add the crafted-residue negative vectors to schc_compression.json. Discovered-from: project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.3.5.2.7
